    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",

      "band": "Unranked",

    },
    {
      "name": "tests",

      "evidence": "Removes assumeutxo test suites and fuzz harnesses.",

      "rationale": "Test deletions directly follow the removal of validation functionality and do not touch test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",

      "evidence": "Minor modifications to startup checks in src/init.cpp.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Startup alterations merely reject datadirs with incomplete snapshots."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Heavily alters validation by removing concurrent chainstates, background historical validation, and snapshot loading across src/validation.cpp, src/node/chainstate.cpp, and src/node/blockstorage.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The proposal addresses the substantial ongoing cognitive load and synchronization edge cases of maintaining multi-chainstate infrastructure in critical validation paths. The description highlights that 'maintaining concurrent chainstates adds pervasive architectural complexity across validation, cache sizing, database lifecycles, pruning bounds, wallet scanning, and block downloading', with reviewers confirming high maintenance costs for a feature that has seen minimal adoption."
    },

    }
